comparisonEdits.before: Duetti is a well-funded, genre-agnostic catalog buyer processing 80+ deals per month using AI-driven valuation. SPACE is a niche specialist that focuses exclusively on ambient, lo-fi, and wellness music with human-led evaluation. Choose Duetti for speed and scale across any genre; choose SPACE if your music is in the ambient/wellness space and you want specialized attention.
comparisonEdits.after: SPACE considers revenue-generating catalogs across all genres, not only ambient or wellness music. Duetti also works with independent music creators. Compare the specific rights, retained income, conditions and services in a written offer rather than assuming either buyer pays more because of genre or technology.

comparisonEdits.before: Duetti and SPACE are both relatively new entrants in the music catalog buying space, but they've taken very different approaches. Duetti, backed by $635 million in funding, has built an AI-powered platform that processes over 80 deals per month across all genres, serving creators earning as little as $2,000 per year. SPACE has carved out a niche in ambient, lo-fi, and wellness music, offering human-led evaluations tailored to the unique dynamics of mood music. Both platforms are designed to be accessible to independent creators, but their philosophies and strengths diverge in meaningful ways. Here's how they compare.
comparisonEdits.after: Choosing between SPACE and Duetti starts with the rights you control and the income you are willing to sell. This comparison is published by SPACE, a direct catalog buyer, not an independent ranking service. Public first-party sources were checked September 16, 2026; no private offers, valuation models or service quality were tested. Earlier unsourced funding and monthly deal-count figures are not used as evidence of what a creator will receive.

comparisonEdits.before: SPACE is a direct music rights buyer specializing in ambient, lo-fi, meditation, and wellness genres. The platform uses human evaluators with expertise in mood music to assess catalog value, considering factors like playlist placement potential, sync licensing fit for wellness apps, and long-tail streaming patterns unique to these genres. SPACE offers both full and partial rights purchases with a focus on personalized service.
comparisonEdits.after: SPACE reviews revenue-generating catalogs from independent artists, producers, labels and catalog owners across all genres. Hip-hop, R&B, pop and rock are considered alongside ambient, lo-fi and electronic music. A review assesses documented income, ownership and the defined interest proposed for sale. Genre alone does not guarantee an offer or exclude an application.

Their technology-first approach allows them to handle high volumes while maintaining fast turnaround times.

comparisonEdits.before: Duetti and SPACE are both creator-friendly platforms, but they excel in different areas. Duetti's strength is scale — backed by $635M in funding, they can process a high volume of deals across every genre quickly using AI-driven valuation. If you're a creator in any genre looking for a fast, efficient transaction, Duetti is a strong option. SPACE's strength is depth in a specific market. If your music is ambient, lo-fi, or wellness-focused, SPACE's human evaluators understand the nuances of mood music that a general-purpose AI model might miss — things like long-tail streaming patterns in meditation playlists, sync value for wellness apps, and the growing demand for functional music. The best choice depends on your genre and priorities. For ambient and wellness creators who value specialized expertise and personal attention, SPACE is the more tailored option. For creators in other genres, or those who prioritize the backing of a heavily funded platform, Duetti is the practical choice.
comparisonEdits.after: There is no evidenced universal winner for every catalog. Ask both buyers to evaluate the same recordings, income streams, ownership share and proposed duration. Compare the cash payable, payment conditions, retained income, reserved rights and continuing duties. If catalog development matters, identify the services actually included in writing. A larger headline offer is not necessarily better if it purchases more rights, and choosing to keep the catalog remains an option.

comparisonEdits.before: Ambient, lo-fi, and wellness creators who want a buyer that deeply understands their niche, offers personalized valuation, and supports partial rights sales.
comparisonEdits.after: Independent owners across genres who want a free, no-obligation review for a direct sale of defined catalog interests.

comparisonEdits.before: Creators across all genres who want a fast, scalable, and well-funded buyer with AI-powered valuation and a high volume of completed deals.
comparisonEdits.after: Independent creators evaluating Duetti's purchase and catalog-service proposal. Confirm the fit and terms directly.

comparisonEdits.before: Duetti uses machine learning models trained on large datasets to assess catalog value quickly and consistently across all genres. SPACE uses human evaluators with specific expertise in ambient and wellness music. For niche genres, human evaluation may capture subtleties — like sync potential for meditation apps — that broad AI models don't fully account for. For mainstream genres, AI-driven valuation can be highly effective and faster.
comparisonEdits.after: We have not tested either valuation process against comparable private offers. A label such as AI or human evaluation does not establish a higher price or better result. Ask how the proposed rights, revenue history, costs, concentration and uncertainty affect the actual written offer rather than treating a process label as proof.

comparisonEdits.before: Duetti's deal structures vary, and partial rights options may be available depending on the specific agreement. SPACE explicitly offers partial rights sales as a standard option, allowing creators to sell a percentage of their royalties while retaining ownership.
comparisonEdits.after: Duetti describes partial master, publishing and royalty-interest options. SPACE also considers defined partial catalog interests. Specify the tracks, percentage, revenue streams, term and retained rights; a partial sale still gives up the agreed interest and associated income.

comparisonEdits.before: Duetti's AI-driven platform is well-suited for evaluating catalogs of all sizes efficiently, including larger catalogs that benefit from automated analysis. However, they also serve creators earning as little as $2,000 per year, so catalog size isn't a barrier on either platform.
comparisonEdits.after: Catalog size alone does not establish which buyer is preferable. Check each provider's current requirements and compare written proposals for the same scope. Do not treat a minimum eligibility statement as a guaranteed acceptance or assume a company funding total predicts the price of your catalog.

comparisonEdits.before: SPACE is specifically built for this market. Their evaluators understand the unique streaming patterns, playlist ecosystems, and sync licensing opportunities in the wellness and meditation space. If your catalog is primarily meditation or wellness-focused, SPACE's specialized expertise is a meaningful advantage.
comparisonEdits.after: Request comparable offers rather than assuming the genre determines a winner. SPACE considers meditation and wellness alongside other genres. There is no private-offer evidence on this page showing that either buyer consistently pays more for those recordings. Document the actual revenue and rights, and review the proposed agreement independently.
